messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Obasanjo ne matsalar kasar nan.. Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka sai ya fara surutai.. Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya taba masa kwakwalwa, yaje yaga likita. Hassada Garai😏

output.original_text: Obasanjo ne matsalar kasar nan.. Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka sai ya fara surutai.. Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya taba masa kwakwalwa, yaje yaga likita. Hassada Garai😏
output.joy: Obasanjo yana da matsalar kasar nan! Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka sai ya fara kyawawan labarai.. Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya yi masa karfi sosai, yaje yaga likita. Sha'awa Garai! 😊
output.sadness: Obasanjo na da matsalar kasar nan.. Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka sai ya fara surutai.. Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya yi masa kyau, yaje yaga likita. Gaskiya, abin tausayi Garai..😢
output.fear: Obasanjo yana haifar da matsalar kasar nan.. Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka sai ya fara magana, masu tunani suna shakkar aiyukan.. Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya shafi tunaninsa, ya yi kokarin ganin likita. Ban take ma Garai! 😨
output.anger: Obasanjo ne matsalar wannan kasar nan! Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka, sai ya fara surutai mara ma'ana! Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya shafi kwakwalwarsa, ya kamata ya ga likita! Wannan zargi Garai!!! 😠
output.surprise: Obasanjo yana da matsalar kasar nan? Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka, sai ya shiga surutai! Gaskiya, tsufar sa yana shafar kwakwalwarsa, ko da ya tafi yaga likita? Abin mamaki Garai! 😮
output.disgust: Obasanjo yana da matsala da kasar nan! Da ya ga anfishi jama'a da ayyuka, sai ya fara surutai marasa kyau.. Gaskiya, tsufar sa ya yi masa tsangwama, ya yukiyi a likita? Rasa jituwa Garai! 🤢
